definition_of_done_items.DOD-02: Every production user-triggerable transition and visible control is exercised.
definition_of_done_items.DOD-03: Every meaningful boundary and security-relevant rejection path is covered.
definition_of_done_items.DOD-04: Every deterministically inducible user-visible error is covered.
definition_of_done_items.DOD-05: Every QR/export format round-trips through its corresponding parser/importer.
definition_of_done_items.DOD-06: Every destructive action tests cancel and commit.
definition_of_done_items.DOD-07: Every persistent setting is verified across reboot.
definition_of_done_items.DOD-08: Every hardware-backed feature has actual hardware evidence, not only injected controller state.
definition_of_done_items.DOD-09: Production and QA/developer surfaces remain separated.
definition_of_done_items.DOD-10: CI detects future uncovered production states/actions.
definition_of_done_items.DOD-11: Final physical CoreS3 suite completes without panic, deadlock, timeout, state mismatch, or unexpected user-visible error.

On sacrificial production-profile CoreS3 hardware with Secure Boot still disabled, enroll a known owner RSA-3072 key from OWNERKEY.KAS. Verify official digest slot 0 and owner digest slot 1 match the expected keys, slot 2 is permanently closed, trusted-key revoke controls are protected, and a second/different enrollment is refused.
Enable Pop It! only after owner enrollment. Verify Secure Boot becomes hardware enforced, official vendor-signed firmware still boots, and owner-key enrollment is permanently unavailable afterward.

Install an OWNERFW.BIN signed by the enrolled owner key. Verify exact owner-key acceptance, hardware anti-rollback enforcement, inactive-OTA selection only after full verification, rejection of an unrelated signing key, and preservation of the previously selected OTA after every failed install.
